reviews.title: Please use anything else
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app for a long time. I had a streak of 760 days so I’ve experienced this app in its fullest. Let me just say this app is one of the worst I’ve used in a long time. The app itself just looks so plain and boring but even that aside the app simply doesn’t work. The whole point of this app is sending notes and having a streak but the streaks are so broken they are constantly expiring despite you sending notes at the same time daily. The app fails to send notifications and when it does it’s far too late. You can just tell that the app is made to farm money off of buying streak repairs. The repairs are not only absurdly expensive along with the membership but in my experience I’ve never even received the streak repairs when I bought them. 

In conclusion when you first download the app it’s not bad at first but if you actually want to have a streak honestly just download Snapchat because everything there isn’t locked behind a paywall like it is on this app. Even something as simple as adding a sticker is a paid feature. Shame on the developers please use anything else 

If I could give this negative stars I would
